plugins.name: Split Notes
plugins.author: GreenSplit
plugins.summary: Keep the next route note visible without crowding your splits.
plugins.description: A compact notes component with per-split instructions, automatic progression, and a presentation mode designed for streams.

plugins.name: Input Canvas
plugins.author: Mira Stone
plugins.summary: A clean keyboard and controller input display for your layout.
plugins.description: Shows live inputs using several compact themes, customizable labels, and animation timings that match GreenSplit's visual language.

plugins.name: Pace Coach
plugins.author: SableWorks
plugins.summary: Rolling pace projections that adapt as your run develops.
plugins.description: Adds focused pace cards for likely finish time, recoverable time, and recent consistency without changing your comparison data.

plugins.name: Stream Labels
plugins.author: GreenSplit
plugins.summary: Write timer and split values to OBS-friendly text files.
plugins.description: Exports selected run values only when they change, with customizable filenames and formatting for simple streaming setups.

plugins.name: AutoSplit Lab
plugins.author: Frame Perfect
plugins.summary: Build and test lightweight autosplitting rules inside GreenSplit.
plugins.description: A community toolkit for prototyping process-reading rules, inspecting values, and sharing game-specific autosplit presets.

plugins.name: Race Relay
plugins.author: Northstar Timing
plugins.summary: Follow friends' race progress in a compact comparison panel.
plugins.description: Displays remote runner status, current split, and finish state with reconnect handling suited to community races.

plugins.name: Run Journal
plugins.author: Kite
plugins.summary: Attach searchable notes and goals to individual attempts.
plugins.description: Keeps a local practice journal with attempt notes, tags, and small prompts that appear after a reset or completed run.

plugins.name: Focus Mode
plugins.author: Quiet Byte
plugins.summary: Hide selected layout details during high-pressure segments.
plugins.description: Switches groups of components using split ranges so you can reduce visual noise during execution-heavy parts of a run.
